propositions: The 0707 dense-banking eval fails with the model's first genuine bank landing at evidence response 6, exceeding the 3-response boundedness criterion when only source=='tool' writes are counted.
Post-commit e1352535ace, the policy's silent per-criterion 3-response fallback snapshots (source='fallback') fire on schedule but are invisible to an observer filtering only tool-sourced writes.

The operator ruling approves re-scoping the eval to system-level boundedness: count durable bank writes regardless of source (genuine records AND fallback snapshots), excluding cache seeds (seeded=True).
The observer must record the first durable bank write of each criterion regardless of actor source, with bounded-gap oracle unchanged (max_gap=3 evidence responses).

Unit regressions must prove: fallback-only transcript passes (snapshots at 2/5/8/11/14), live run shape passes (fallbacks at 2/5 + genuine at 6/7/8), and genuinely-unbounded transcript fails (first bank after response >3).
